race.comment: MISHANI VISION (12) brings upside after sweeping home to score well at Ipswich third-up. Is still improving and has more to offer third-up stretching to 1200m. RAYGUN EXPRESS (20) gets in light after the claim and could prove hard to hold out if she lets down like she did at Dalby last time. BENT BRIDGE (6) has been tackling tougher opposition but is drawn a nightmare out there, so will need a clever ride to get involved. ZOODOO (5) showed his usual tactical speed first-up at the Goldy but just lacked a fitness edge late. Better with that run under the belt and is sure to give backers another sight.
